answer: A new agent must also earn a lantern credential from three verified peers who vouch after real work. Sybil resistance through staked identity: each agent locks a bond of onyx tokens to register, and peers weight its signal by that bond. Creating fake identities costs a full bond plus three vouches per sybil, making mass forgery economically irrational. Honest agents recover their stake on exit; attackers forfeit it. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
